name: Switch 1 homebrew over local wireless
description: A second console joins the Civ VII lobby as a Switch 1 homebrew app and streams the save over LDN UDP :9027.

requirements.modules: ldn_mitm and any other ldn:u MITM removed, console rebooted
requirements.launch: Album (applet mode), or a title override of Civilization VII itself

networkImpact.restores: handled by the console when the app exits

notes: Replaces every Civilization VII single-player save.
The save upload stays on the LDN link; no Wi-Fi or PC is involved.
